title: Analysis and Numerics of a Stationary Drift-Diffusion Model for Electrical Discharge in MEMS
summary: This work presents the analysis and numerical simulation of a stationary drift-diffusion model for electrical discharge in micro-electro-mechanical systems (MEMS). The model couples Poisson's equation for the electrostatic potential with continuity equations for positive ions and electrons, incorporating a Townsend-type impact ionization source term that depends exponentially on the electric field magnitude.
